items.title: Design patterns for application-specific custom Linux distributions
items.summary: Best practices for building stripped-down embedded Linux distros with read-only root.
items.content: Comprehensive paper reviewing Track A operating systems architectures. Emphasizes frozen system contracts, cryptographic append-only audit ledgers, and zero-freeform-shell execution policies.

items.title: Mitigating Prompt Injection via Formal Context-Free Grammars
items.summary: Constraining LLM sampling tokens using GBNF grammars prevents instruction escapes.
items.content: Researchers demonstrate that grammar-constrained decoding at inference time renders prompt injection structurally incapable of violating output schemas or executing unauthorized shell commands.
